test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: general
question:
The curved surface area of a right circular cone is 2310 cm² and its radius is 21 cm. If its radius is increased by 100% and height is reduced by 50%, then its capacity (in litres) will be (correct to one decimal place):

(Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Slant height l = CSA ÷ (πr) = 2310 ÷ (22/7 × 21) = 35 cm.

Height h = √(l² − r²) = √(35² − 21²) = 28 cm.

New r = 2r = 42 cm and New h = h/2 = 14 cm.

New Volume = 2 × Initial Volume = 2 × (1/3 × 22/7 × 21² × 28) = 25872 cm³.

Capacity = 25872 ÷ 1000 = 25.872 litres ≈ 25.9 litres.

**∴ The correct answer is 25.9 litres.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2310 cm², Radius (r) = 21 cm.

Formula used: CSA = πrl, h² = l² − r², Volume (V) = (1/3)πr²h.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09fb12eb1a10ae9f4ae7e785754389bd9d9091b448f7f5f0bdb8940fc2753927.png] 

⇒ 2310 = (22/7) × 21 × l

⇒ 2310 = 66 × l ⇒ l = 2310 ÷ 66 = 35 cm

⇒ h = √(35² − 21²) = √(1225 − 441) = √784 = 28 cm

⇒ New radius (r') = 21 + 100% of 21 = 42 cm

⇒ New height (h') = 28 − 50% of 28 = 14 cm

⇒ New Volume (V') = 1/3 × 22/7 × 42 × 42 × 14

⇒ V' = 22 × 2 × 42 × 14 = 25872 cm³

⇒ Capacity in litres = 25872 ÷ 1000 = 25.872 litres

⇒ Rounded to one decimal place = 25.9 litres

**∴ The correct answer is 25.9 litres.**

**__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a Cone

The total surface area includes the curved surface and the base area: TSA = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r).

Unit Conversion (Volume)

1 litre = 1000 cm³ | 1 m³ = 1000 litres.

Slant Height Calculation

For any right circular cone, slant height (l), radius (r), and height (h) form a right-angled triangle: l² = r² + h².

Effect of Dimension Changes on Volume

If radius is scaled by x and height by y, then the volume is scaled by x² × y.</p
